long_description: What it is: A creamy multistick for cheeks and lips that glides on, melts into skin, and builds a natural flushed-from-within look that lasts all day. Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free. What Else You Need to Know: This formula, shades, and packaging is designed for both cheeks and lips with the ideal balance of glide, finish + lasting power. Buildable pigment blends easily before setting comfortably. Melts seamlessly into skin, layers over or under creams + powders for a soft, natural-looking flush with a blurred finish. These neutral tones can be easily replicated across multiple parts of your face for a cohesive monochromatic look. Clinical Results: In clinical tests it was found to be: - Long-wearing for 12 hours on cheeks and lips Based on a consumer perception study of 32 women after using Impressionist Multistick, after 1 week: - 100% agreed they would purchase Impressionist Multistick - 100% agreed Impressionist is better than other multisticks they’ve tried Based on a clinical study of 32 women after using Impressionist Multistick, after 1 week: - 100% saw on bare cheeks and lips - Improved hydration, skin texture/smoothing, and plumping/lifting
how_to_use: Suggested Usage: - Apply to cheeks + lips and blend with fingers or a brush. Can be layered over or under other makeup. Hot Tip: Perfect pigment load + shade range for underpainting. Apply under makeup for a natural flush from within. @paintedbyesther's Melted Flush Blush Technique featuring Impressionist Multistick: - Underpaint the Flush. Apply the first layer of blush using Impressionist Multistick in a soft color like Muse to the back of the hand. Pick up with a powder brush and lightly pat (never swipe) onto apples of the cheeks, blend out and upward, stopping at the tail of the eyebrow. The Impressionist melts seamlessly into the skin while still holding its color, even when you start layering other complexion products on top. - Brighten + Blend. Apply one dot of Revealer Concealer (sold separately) in the corners under each eye and to the sides of the nose. Use the Face Detailer Brush or Cloud Puff (sold separately) to lightly tap and blend under the eyes and around the nose to clean and soften the edges of the blush. This helps create that flushed-from-within look. - Blur + Set. Pat on Cloud Set Loose Brightening Powder in Translucent Candy (sold separately) with a puff to blur and set the makeup. This powder helps sweep away shine but keeps the glow. - Lift. Apply the next layer of blush using Impressionist Multistick in a brighter color like Vibration. Apply to the back of the hand. Using a puff lightly pat, starting at the highest point of the cheek bone and lightly buff out and upward along the cheek bone towards the tail of the brow. The Impressionist has a soft-focus finish for a watercolor effect that looks so natural on skin. - Monochromatic Cheeks + Lips. Apply Impressionist Multistick in Vibration to the back of the hand. Using the Multitasking Eye Brush (sold separately), apply Impressionist Multistick to the lips, feathering out from right above the cupid's bow. This pulls the final look together beautifully.

long_description: What it is: A groundbreaking hybrid that combines the customized lighting effects of Ambient Lighting Powder or Strobe Powder with a spectrum of breathtakingly modern hues. The handmade powders are formulated using an advanced miscelare techniquewhich means "to mix" in Italiancreating the perfect balance of pigment and powder. No two look alike. The Ambient® Lighting Blush Collection features airy, lightweight blushes to flatter a range of skin tones. Hourglass’s original collection of Ambient® Lighting Blush fuses universally flattering Ambient Lighting Powders with vivid cheek colors for soft-focus, multidimensional color with a naturally radiant finish. What it is formulated WITHOUT: - Parabens - Sulfates - Phthalates What else you need to know: The optically transparent particles alter the appearance of the skin by manipulating and refracting favorable light. The result is skin that looks smooth, even, and enhancednot masked. The soft-focus technology helps to minimize the look of wrinkles and imperfections, neutralize discoloration, and emulate the appearance of young, healthy skin. "Traditional blush can read as flat, and so I was inspired to create something that was far more seamless. The Ambient Lighting Blush Collection fuses two advanced formulas to create something entirely new. It’s unlike any other product on the market."Carisa Janes, Hourglass Brand Founder Hourglass products are 100 percent cruelty-free.
